channel.title: The Rep Rot Blog
channel.description: Practical guides for spending less time scrolling and more time moving.

item.title: Willpower Isn't the Problem. Your Feed Is Built for This.
item.description: Why you can't stop scrolling even when you want to, and why the answer isn't more discipline: it's changing what happens when the urge hits.

item.title: The Phone Is the Enemy of Focus: Brian Chesky's Big-Screen Rule
item.description: Airbnb's Brian Chesky says attention span shrinks with screen size. What the research says, and how to use his big-screen rule to focus better.

item.title: How to Stop Doomscrolling on iPhone (Without Deleting Your Apps)
item.description: A practical setup to stop doomscrolling on iPhone: the Screen Time settings that matter in iOS 27, the friction that actually works, and what to do instead.

item.title: How to Stay Consistent With Working Out: Adjust, Don't Miss
item.description: Two lifters, two rules for staying consistent with working out: get good at one thing at a time, and on bad days make it easier instead of skipping.

item.title: Exercise Snacks: Why One-Minute Workouts Count
item.description: Exercise snacks are short bursts of hard effort spread across the day. What the research shows, how to do them at home, and a simple plan to start.
